name: Password Sign-In Rejected
summary: Records a non-enumerating password sign-in rejection while preserving an anonymous session regardless of whether the internal cause is invalid credentials or an unknown account.

guards.expression: password authentication is not accepted and the outcome is not account lockout

sourceReferences.note: Maps AUTH001 invalid-credentials results to this canonical transition.
Unknown-account and invalid-password branches return the same public AUTH001 result while retaining different internal audit events.
Two integration proofs cover invalid credentials and unknown account under this one canonical rejection outcome.
